name: Ship Performance Fix
author: tidic84
description: No more freeze when you build on big ships. After every hull panel the game rebuilds the ship's rooms (the air and oxygen zones) by walking the whole outside of the hull or the whole room, which takes tens of milliseconds per panel at 2,000 parts. Ship Performance Fix gets the same rooms by walking only around the change: placing a panel drops from about 40 ms to under 1 ms. Also lets players join a world with very big ships: past about 30,000 hull panels the world sent to a joining player went over Steam's 512 KB message limit and they loaded forever; the host now splits it. Also raises the frame rate near big ships: the game moved every client collider of every ship each physics tick even when the ship stood still, and measured every ship voxel by voxel each frame; with two big ships in view the game went from about 32 to about 100 fps. Big ships use PhysX's speculative collision detection on the host instead of sweeping thousands of shapes: a big ship moving along the ground costs about half as much physics. On the host, a big ship's thousands of corner colliders are taken out of the physics wherever the hull is far from the ground and other ships (its inertia is kept), which divides the host physics by two to three. Loading or spawning a big ship builds its air octree about 20 % faster (same rooms). With TF Advanced, its force field doors are animated only while on screen and twice as cheaply (same colours). Works with any ship, no new content, saves untouched. Multiplayer: each player who installs it gets the gain on their own machine, and the host needs it for big-ship joins; mixing with players who don't have it is fine.
